en.why_it_matters: This is not just another Coltrane-centennial tribute. The Baltimore performance lands on September 23, 2026 — John Coltrane's exact 100th birthday — and puts the music in the hands of Isaiah Collier, a younger saxophonist whose own work already treats the post-Coltrane spiritual and free-jazz lineage as living material rather than repertory. The date gives the night real historical gravity; Collier's improvisational language keeps it pointed toward the present.
en.trip_verdict: S. Protect the night and make the DMV-to-Baltimore trip specifically for this set if the Coltrane lineage matters to you. It stays below S+ because Collier Plays Coltrane is an active touring project rather than a one-off reunion or farewell, but performing it on Coltrane's exact centennial birthday gives this Baltimore stop unusual weight.

La fecha le da un peso histórico verdadero; el lenguaje improvisatorio de Collier mantiene la mirada puesta en el presente.
